facts: Parties: Upton Media Ltd (Buyer), Northgate Media Ltd (Seller); the Company is Quayside Capital LLP.
This Agreement is dated 27 February 2026; Closing is scheduled for 4 April 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 27 February 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Kingsmere Engineering Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $2,750,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 12 July 2026.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
